text:
Carmen: Heads-up — we have a webinar + benchmark launch scheduled for Wed 4/21. Need X thread, LinkedIn carousel, and a 1-pager. Also routing for inbound leads (webinar form -> SDR queue). cc @Maya @Leo @Priya :wave:
Maya: I can draft the X thread + 3 short tweets. Need 2 asset cards (benchmark chart + pull quote). ETA EOD Mon.
Leo: LinkedIn carousel — can we repurpose the benchmark slide deck? I can make 3 card variations and A/B the lead CTA.
Priya: For routing: use existing webinar form -> Zapier -> Salesforce queue "SDR-Marketing". Need form owner to add a "product_interest" field. @Carmen who owns the form today?
Carmen: I'll own the form. @Marcom-bot can you drop the current form link?
Marcom-bot: current form (preview): https://airtable.com/shrABC123 — update access set to "marketing-edit".
Maya: Messaging note: leaning into "predictable latency & unit-cost" headline + benchmark bullets. Draft copy: "Redwood Inference reduces gen latency by 2x at ~60% lower per-token cost vs baseline." Need Legal sign-off for the "2x" claim.
Ethan: Legal OK if we cite the benchmark doc and include test conditions. I'll loop legal (legal@redwood.ai) — can someone drop the raw numbers.
Leo: Scheduling rec: X at 10:00 PT, LinkedIn at 11:00 PT, boosted post ~12:00 PT. That sequence gives visibility and capture. :calendar: Does that work?
Priya: Works for routing. For live coverage: SDR rotation — @Ethan will triage first 4 hours, then handover to Zoe. Need a Slack channel for live alerts.
Carmen: I'll create #launch-webinar-live and add the SDRs + ops. Quick checklist: 1) Assets by Mon noon, 2) Landing page UTM params, 3) Form field + flow to SF, 4) Paid budget + creatives. Ping if blocked.
Maya: Uploading drafts to /marketing/launchsprints/assets by EOD. Sample X thread snippet attached below:
```text
1/ Today we’re publishing a new benchmark comparing inference runtimes.
2/ Key finding: 2x latency improvement + 60% cost reduction at 95th pctile.
3/ TL;DR: predictable latency + lower unit economics = easier productionization.
(…)
```
Leo: I’ll export carousel PNGs and tag them in Figma (file: Figma › Marketing › Benchmarks). ETA Tue AM.
Priya: Also proposing a 24h nurture email and a LinkedIn message template for inbound leads. I’ll draft both and add to the assets folder.
Carmen: Final ask — can someone own live engagement follow-ups (DMs/comments) for the first 4 hours? @Ethan volunteer? :raised_hands: 
Ethan: I got the first 4 hours. I’ll post an engagement tracker link to the channel when we go live.
Marcom-bot: Reminder set — schedule posts at 1972510000 (X) and 1972513600 (LinkedIn).
Carmen: Thanks team — we’ll sync Tue morning if any blockers.
